drafts.sentence: cce doctor must report a present but invalid workspace.yml as a definite-corruption failure and exit non-zero instead of silently degrading to single-directory mode, and cce sync pull must refuse to overwrite the local index at a different sha without --force when .cce/synced.json is present but corrupt.

When an OCPP or Modbus module view stops or (re)starts its backend on a settings change, version switch, or stop/restart/reload command, a failure of that stop or start shall be reported in the module message log at Error level rather than silently discarded.

Every remaining production .catch(() => {}) on a mutating or teardown path must route its failure to the LogViewer via frontendError, or be wrapped in the fireAndForget(promise, reason) helper with a stated reason, instead of silently swallowing it.
Restorer::process_chunk must propagate an error from set_base_root_key instead of silently discarding it and continuing to restore on corrupt state.

Credential and profile writes must report failures instead of swallowing them: the durable atomic write must fail if flushing, syncing, or setting 0600 permissions fails, the alias command must abort rather than overwrite a shell profile it could not read, and isolate setup must warn when linking host files or writing isolate.json fails.

agent_message must not report delivered for a target_session_id whose session has already finished, returning target_session_finished instead, and must not report target_agent_not_found for an agent that is installed through the alias registry.

Recurring enqueue, for both cron execution and manual run-now, must propagate an error from resolving a job's concurrency constraint, naming the recurring task key, instead of swallowing it and inserting an unrestricted ready job.

Hook regeneration and baseline updates must not silently swallow failures, so that a failure to regenerate a tampered hook or to update or generate the baseline is logged with context rather than ignored.
validate_destination must reject a destination under a blocked prefix even when the path does not exist yet, instead of silently passing it.

omamori must not hang or be silently misled when a FIFO, directory, or symlink is planted at a path it reads, such as audit.jsonl.hwm, break-glass.json, or config.toml, so that hook-check still prints its verdict.

omamori doctor must not report '[Staging] empty' for a staging directory it could not read or could only list partway, and a directory listing that stops partway must be treated as no listing at all rather than a shorter one.
hook-check --json-error must record the audit entry for a blocked command instead of giving it up because loading the signing key prints warnings to stderr.
audit verify must report an entry declaring an unrecognized chain_version distinctly and exit 4 even when its seq has the wrong type, instead of counting the line as a torn write.
omamori cursor-hook must return deny, not allow, when it fails to parse its stdin JSON input.
